data.content_ref: inline:The artifact 0bb6167c36cf abstracts the 'error-correction trajectory' in SRC_003 into a general theory of 'Cognitive Scaffolding Efficiency', where the checklist is viewed as a temporary external memory structure. It proposes that reliability gains are refuted if the panel's performance drops significantly when the checklist is removed, suggesting the gain was a dependency on the tool rather than an integration of expertise into the non-experts.
